title: File-type icons are external multi-colour SVGs, hand-authored shell icons are inline JSX at currentColor
context: File icons must be coloured (orange for .rs, blue for .toml) for scanning; shell chrome should adapt to theme.
decision: Carve-out rule: file-type icons only in file lists (Files tree, search locator); they are external Material icons. All chrome (buttons, toggles, chevrons) uses hand-authored JSX at currentColor.
consequences: Tree scanned visually by colour without reading filenames. Chrome adapts to all themes. Two different icon systems for two different purposes.
